[LTIM.2.5.2] Besides a new false → true edge on the same wrapper
([LTIM.2.5.1]), the firing re-arms on a new **fact wrapper** (`fact_id`), not
the identity key ([LFAC.1.7]): a meaningful change to the matched fact mints a new
wrapper via retract+assert ([LFAC.2.5.3] / [LFAC.1.2.2]), and that new wrapper
re-arms and may fire again once the condition holds for it. Both an identity-key
change and a mutable-slot update re-arm — each mints a new wrapper. A no-op
reassertion preserves the wrapper and does not re-arm. A retracted fact that later
re-matches likewise re-arms (new wrapper).

idris.note: THE EDGE RE-ARMS ON A NEW WRAPPER: the gate opens at 6 and fires once; a second pump fires nothing; the Sensor is retracted and asserted again, a new wrapper, which fires once more and then not again -- logical/LTIM.2.5.2_now_edge_once_rearm's shape. 'A retracted fact that later re-matches likewise re-arms (new wrapper).' Executed: `[[(0, True)], [], [(0, True)], []]`.
